images.name: tool-horoscope
images.prompt: Generate one square flat illustrated small mobile utility icon. Attached existing membership icon is STYLE REFERENCE only, not subject. Match its thick smooth muted purple outlines (#54458c), orange/golden accents, white fills, simple friendly shapes. A simple crystal ball showing a small zodiac constellation and a few stars. Clear recognizable horoscope symbol. Center symbol occupying about 72% of square, on a white circular disk filling 94% of canvas, genuinely transparent outside disk. Same visual weight as reference, no gradients, shadows, 3D, text, labels, or extra objects. Output transparent PNG.
